description: This file defines the Node IP Address Management (IPAM) controller for Kubernetes, including the Controller struct, constructor, and run methods, managing node CIDRs and cloud provider integration.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages node IPAM state, including CIDR allocation and cloud provider integration.

methods.name: NewNodeIpamController
methods.description: Constructs a new Controller instance, initializing CIDR allocators and cloud provider settings.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the IPAM controller, monitoring node status and managing CIDRs.

methods.name: RunWithMetrics
methods.description: Runs the controller with metrics tracking for start and stop events.
